meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right
meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'править'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fix, to correct', paired with 'исправлять'.

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

examples.text: Да, вы знаете, это очень серьёзная операция. Мы всё исправим. До свидания!
examples.trans: Yes, you know, it is a very serious operation. We'll fix everything. Goodbye!

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to bring (carrying)', paired with 'приносить'.

examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
